[!isolates] skip
# Explicit entries preserve typed invocation, state selection and cache identity.
[short] skip
go build -isolate-config=isolate.json -isolate-report=ownership.json -o host.exe ./host
exec ./host.exe
stdout 'ordinary before 42'
stdout 'marked first:x:42'
stdout 'marked second:y:42'
stdout 'ordinary after 43'
stdout 'signature preserved'
go run ./reportcheck ownership.json
! go build -isolate-report=unused.json ./reportcheck
stderr '-isolate-report requires explicit isolate entries in the host import graph'
! go build -isolate-config=isolate.json -isolate-report=clobber.exe -o clobber.exe ./host
stderr '-isolate-report must differ from executable output'

# The cached build must retain generated invokers and state metadata.
go build -isolate-config=isolate.json -o cached.exe ./host
exec ./cached.exe
stdout 'marked second:y:42'
stdout 'billing invoice-1:100'
stdout 'billing invoice-2:100'
stdout 'billing host after 101'

# The trusted entry wrapper must not be inlined into an instrumented caller.
# Race builds force the handle-bearing environment onto the host heap, making
# an accidental application-side read observable by the ownership diagnostic.
go build -isolate-config=isolate.json -race -gcflags=example.org/isolatefunctiontest/host=-d=isolateheap=2 -o owned-entry.exe ./host
exec ./owned-entry.exe
stdout 'marked first:x:42'
stdout 'marked second:y:42'
stdout 'billing invoice-1:100'
stdout 'billing invoice-2:100'
stdout 'signature preserved'

# The generated entry table and descriptors remain valid when stacks move.
[cgo] [race] go build -isolate-config=isolate.json -race -gcflags=runtime=-d=maymorestack=runtime.mayMoreStackMove -o moved-entry.exe ./host
[cgo] [race] exec ./moved-entry.exe
[cgo] [race] stdout 'billing invoice-2:100'

# Isolate functions cannot borrow process-owned globals.
! go build -isolate-config=isolate.json -o badglobal.exe ./badglobal
stderr 'isolate: code references process-owned global os.Stdout'
stderr 'isolate: code references process-owned global os.Stdin'
stderr 'isolate: code references process-owned global os.Stderr'
stderr 'isolate: code references process-owned global os.Args'
stderr 'isolate: code references process-owned global flag.CommandLine'
! go build -isolate-config=isolate.json -o badread.exe ./badread
stderr 'isolate: code references process-owned global os.Args'
stderr 'isolate: code references process-owned global os.Stdout'
stderr 'isolate: code references process-owned global flag.CommandLine'

# Low-level package-state selection checks apply without a workflow executable.
! go build -isolate-config=isolate.json -gcflags=all=-d=isolatepackages=encoding/json encoding/json
stderr 'isolate: code writes unselected imported global encoding/json/internal.TransformMarshalError'
! go build -isolate-config=isolate.json -gcflags=all=-d=isolatepackages=main -o rejectmutation.exe ./badmutation
stderr -count=2 'isolate: code writes unselected imported global example.org/isolatefunctiontest/processstate.Map'
stderr -count=2 'isolate: code writes unselected imported global example.org/isolatefunctiontest/processstate.Channel'
stderr -count=2 'isolate: code writes unselected imported global example.org/isolatefunctiontest/processstate.Slice'

-- go.mod --
module example.org/isolatefunctiontest

go 1.26
-- jobs/jobs.go --
package jobs

import (
    "encoding/json"
    "time"
)

var counter = 41

type Request struct { Name string }
type Response struct { Message string; Counter int }

// Explicit isolate entry in isolate.json.
func Work(request Request, suffix string, delay time.Duration) (Response, error) {
    data, err := json.Marshal(request)
    if err != nil { return Response{}, err }
    if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &request); err != nil { return Response{}, err }
    counter++
    return Response{request.Name + ":" + suffix, counter}, nil
}

// Explicit isolate entry in isolate.json.
func other() error { return nil }

func PlainCounter() int { counter++; return counter }
func Other() any { return other }
-- reportcheck/main.go --
package main

import (
    "encoding/json"
    "os"
)

func main() {
    data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
    if err != nil { panic(err) }
    var report struct {
        Programs []struct {
            Name string `json:"name"`
            Packages []string `json:"packages"`
        } `json:"programs"`
    }
    if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &report); err != nil { panic(err) }
    want := map[string]bool{
        "example.org/isolatefunctiontest/jobs.Work": false,
        "example.org/isolatefunctiontest/jobs.other": false,
        "example.org/isolatefunctiontest/billing.Issue": false,
    }
    for _, program := range report.Programs {
        if _, ok := want[program.Name]; !ok { panic("unexpected program " + program.Name) }
        want[program.Name] = true
    }
    if len(report.Programs) != len(want) { panic("wrong program count") }
    for name, found := range want { if !found { panic("missing program " + name) } }
}
-- badglobal/main.go --
package main

import (
    "flag"
    "os"
)

// Explicit isolate entry in isolate.json.
func Bad() {
    os.Stdout = nil
    os.Stdin = nil
    os.Stderr = nil
    os.Args[0] = "bad"
    flag.CommandLine.Usage = nil
}

func main() {}
-- badread/main.go --
package main

import (
    "flag"
    "os"
)

// Explicit isolate entry in isolate.json.
func Bad() {
    args := os.Args
    if len(args) != 0 { args[0] = "bad" }
    out := os.Stdout
    if out == nil { panic("missing stdout") }
    flags := flag.CommandLine
    _ = flags.Set("bad", "value")
}

func main() {}
-- processstate/processstate.go --
package processstate

var Map = map[string]int{}
var Channel = make(chan int, 1)
var Slice = make([]int, 1, 2)
-- badmutation/main.go --
package main

import "example.org/isolatefunctiontest/processstate"

func main() {
    delete(processstate.Map, "x")
    clear(processstate.Map)
    processstate.Channel <- 1
    close(processstate.Channel)
    _ = append(processstate.Slice, 1)
    copy(processstate.Slice, []int{1})
}
-- billing/billing.go --
package billing

import "strconv"

var counter = 99

// Explicit isolate entry in isolate.json.
func Issue(id string) (string, error) {
    counter++
    return id + ":" + strconv.Itoa(counter), nil
}

func PlainCounter() int { counter++; return counter }
-- host/main.go --
package main

import (
    "encoding/json"
    "fmt"
    "isolate"
    "reflect"
    "time"

    "example.org/isolatefunctiontest/billing"
    "example.org/isolatefunctiontest/jobs"
)

func run(name, suffix string) {
    handle, ok := isolate.LookupFunction(jobs.Work)
    if !ok { panic("missing marked function") }
    if handle.Name() != "example.org/isolatefunctiontest/jobs.Work" { panic("wrong function name") }
    if handle.Signature() != reflect.TypeOf(jobs.Work) { panic("wrong signature") }
    if instance, err := isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program: handle.ProgramWithHandle(nil)}); err == nil || instance != nil {
        panic("nil dispatcher accepted")
    }
    program := handle.ProgramWithHandle(func(handle isolate.Handle) {
        input, err := isolate.Call(1, nil)
        if err != nil { panic(err) }
        var args []json.RawMessage
        if err := json.Unmarshal(input, &args); err != nil { panic(err) }
        err = handle.Invoke(func(values ...isolate.Value) error {
            if len(values) != len(args) { panic("wrong argument count") }
            for i, value := range values {
                if err := json.Unmarshal(args[i], value.Pointer); err != nil { return err }
            }
            return nil
        }, func(values ...isolate.Value) error {
            output, err := json.Marshal(values[0].Value)
            if err != nil { return err }
            _, err = isolate.Call(2, output)
            return err
        })
        if err != nil { panic(err) }
    })
    instance, err := isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program: program})
    if err != nil { panic(err) }
    if err := instance.Start(); err != nil { panic(err) }
    var command *isolate.Command
    select {
    case command = <-instance.Commands():
    case <-instance.Done(): panic(instance.Wait())
    }
    input, err := json.Marshal([]any{jobs.Request{Name: name}, suffix, time.Second})
    if err != nil { panic(err) }
    command.Reply(input, nil)
    select {
    case command = <-instance.Commands():
    case <-instance.Done(): panic(instance.Wait())
    }
    var result jobs.Response
    if err := json.Unmarshal(command.Payload, &result); err != nil { panic(err) }
    fmt.Printf("marked %s:%d\n", result.Message, result.Counter)
    command.Reply(nil, nil)
    if err := instance.Wait(); err != nil { panic(err) }
}

func runInvoice(id string) {
    handle, ok := isolate.LookupFunction(billing.Issue)
    if !ok { panic("missing billing workflow") }
    program := handle.ProgramWithHandle(dispatchText)
    instance, err := isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program: program})
    if err != nil { panic(err) }
    if err := instance.Start(); err != nil { panic(err) }
    var command *isolate.Command
    select {
    case command = <-instance.Commands():
    case <-instance.Done(): panic(instance.Wait())
    }
    if command.Op != 1 { panic("unexpected billing operation") }
    command.Reply([]byte(id), nil)
    select {
    case command = <-instance.Commands():
    case <-instance.Done(): panic(instance.Wait())
    }
    if command.Op != 2 { panic("unexpected billing completion") }
    if got, want := string(command.Payload), id+":100"; got != want { panic(fmt.Sprintf("billing result %q, want %q", got, want)) }
    fmt.Printf("billing %s\n", command.Payload)
    command.Reply(nil, nil)
    if err := instance.Wait(); err != nil { panic(err) }
}

func dispatchText(handle isolate.Handle) {
    input, err := isolate.Call(1, nil)
    if err != nil { panic(err) }
    err = handle.Invoke(func(values ...isolate.Value) error {
        if len(values) != 1 { panic("wrong argument count") }
        *values[0].Pointer.(*string) = string(input)
        return nil
    }, func(values ...isolate.Value) error {
        if len(values) != 1 { panic("wrong result count") }
        output, ok := values[0].Value.(string)
        if !ok { panic("wrong result type") }
        _, err := isolate.Call(2, []byte(output))
        return err
    })
    if err != nil { panic(err) }
}

func main() {
    if _, ok := isolate.LookupFunction(jobs.PlainCounter); ok { panic("unmarked function received isolate handle") }
    if _, ok := isolate.LookupFunction(billing.PlainCounter); ok { panic("unmarked billing function received isolate handle") }
    if _, ok := isolate.LookupFunction(jobs.Other()); !ok { panic("private marked function not discovered") }
    fmt.Println("ordinary before", jobs.PlainCounter())
    run("first", "x")
    run("second", "y")
    fmt.Println("ordinary after", jobs.PlainCounter())
    if billing.PlainCounter() != 100 { panic("host billing state changed unexpectedly") }
    runInvoice("invoice-1")
    runInvoice("invoice-2")
    fmt.Println("billing host after", billing.PlainCounter())
    fmt.Println("signature preserved")
}
